fields.description: A label to tell the team's keys apart, set once at the mint and used once per team, ever: a second key with the same title is refused, revoked ones included. Press titles a trial site's key by the site.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The team this key spends for. Its payload-log opt-in and credit verdict ride on the key to the gateway.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: The one geography this key works in; every gateway elsewhere answers 403. Left blank, it is the default Geography. Set once: its spend and rate counters live on that geography's store.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: What this key may spend over its team's Key Cap Window — this UTC month, or everything since the mint: the gateway counts its spend and refuses it at 402 once that reaches the cap. 0 until a cap is set, and the key is refused until then. Across the team's live keys the caps add up to no more than the team's Spend Limit.
fields.label: Cap (USD)

fields.description: When this key retires on its own: never, or so many days after the mint, when the hourly sweep revokes it and the next tick prunes it off the boxes. Set at the mint and fixed after.
fields.label: Expiry

fields.description: The moment Expiry names, set once at the mint; empty is never.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Groups of this key's geography. A new key starts in the one marked default there.
fields.label: Model Groups

fields.description: Models this key may call on top of its groups'. A vendor model is its geography's doc.
fields.label: Allow

fields.description: Models this key may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny

fields.description: Counted on the gateway, per Gateway Store, for this key alone. A window resets on the UTC clock: top of the minute, the hour, midnight, the 1st. No rows: the key runs under its team's Tier, else the default tier, else 20 requests and 100 000 tokens a minute.
fields.label: Limits
